author: rynkovski
name: select
description:
A dropdown select component built on top of Radix UI Select primitive. Supports multiple variants, icons, and custom styling.

Features
- Multiple variants (default, filled, flushed, dashed)
- Custom trigger icons
- Error state handling
- Helper text support
- Scrollable content
- Custom item indicators
- Keyboard navigation
- Accessible by default
- Customizable animations
- Dark mode compatible
